# Flask-ADB-toolkit

> Menu-driven terminal toolkit that wraps adb and fastboot into numbered options for flashing, recovery, and device maintenance.

- Site: https://dedsec-1337.github.io/Flask-ADB-toolkit/
- Repository: https://github.com/dedsec-1337/Flask-ADB-toolkit
- License: MIT
- Author: dedsec-1337
- Last updated: 2026-09-30

## Summary

Flask-ADB-toolkit is a bash script (plus a Windows .bat helper) that turns common Android debugging and flashing workflows into a simple menu. It is aimed at beginners who do not want to memorize long fastboot commands.

## Platforms

- Linux
- macOS
- Windows (flask-adb-toolkit.bat; optional Git Bash / WSL for the full .sh experience)

## Main capabilities

- Auto-detecting ROM folder flash (vbmeta, dtbo, boot, init_boot, vendor_boot, super_empty, zip sideload)
- Generic partition flash and erase on any device
- Bootloader unlock helper, slot switching, fastboot variables
- Recovery reboot and ADB sideload
- SHA256 checksum verification before flashing
- Booted-device tools: performance compile pass, deep clean, battery/storage, logcat, screenshots, APK install, pull/push
- Screenshots save to the user's Downloads folder
- Windows .bat auto-locates platform-tools next to the script or on PATH

## Install (short)

1. Install adb and fastboot (distro packages, Homebrew, or Google platform-tools on Windows).
2. Download flask-adb-toolkit.sh or flask-adb-toolkit.bat from the repository.
3. On Unix: chmod +x and run the .sh. On Windows: place the .bat inside or beside platform-tools and double-click.

## Safety

Dangerous actions require typing YES. Flashing can wipe data or brick devices. Users remain responsible for backups and verifying images.
